findings.title: Converting `.small-action` to flexbox breaks right-alignment of child `button` elements
findings.body: `.small-action` is changed to `display: flex`, making its direct children flex items. Inside `.small-action`, `button` (lines 306-310) relies on `float: right;` to align to the right edge of the post action row, and `.small-action-desc` has no `flex-grow`. Because `float` has no effect on flex items, the delete/edit buttons in `.small-action` will no longer be pushed to the right side and will instead sit immediately next to `.small-action-desc` (unlike `.d-header .panel`, where `margin-left: auto` was added when `float: right` was removed).
